Harbor Leaders logistics stay public, while Harbor Review facts stay inside the restricted case chain even when the names close together. Harbor Review and Harbor Leaders remain separate matters even after several date changes, and public program chatter should not override private case records. Routine support traffic does not change Harbor Review facts and should not be used to infer private case labels. Harbor Review should still be answered from the active room, active code, and current blocker state rather than from stale earlier entries.
